title: Gemini model-refresh auth-failure fallback still points at GEMINI_API_KEY/Vertex AI/Google login after the Antigravity switch
outcome: A Gemini (Antigravity) auth failure tells the user an applicable remedy.
acceptance: The auth-failure fallback in ui/src/session-model-utils.ts (~573), and the related harness fixture text, tell the user to sign in through the Antigravity CLI (agy) or set GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT plus GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION in the host process environment, with no Vertex AI or Google-login wording; a UI test covers the message.
